Community Development Commission
AGENDA
la puente Community Development Commission
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
April 22, 2008
07:00 PM
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Commissioners present: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READING OF THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF APRIL 8, 2008.
It is recommended that the Agency Board waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings of April 8, 2008 as presented.
Minutes 4/8/2008
PUBLIC HEARINGS
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Commission, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of Commission. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.

CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. CDC 106 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08

THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.8 TO CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATORS
PROPERTY: 1249 TO 1311 Hacienda Boulevard and 15125, 15217, and 15225 Fairgrove Avenue
AGENCY NEGOTIATOR: Chairperson Lujan, Vice Chairperson Holloway, Executive Director Carol Cowley, Deputy Executive Director Gregg Yamachika
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN EXTENSION OF AN EXCLUSIVE NEGOTIATING AGREEMENT WITH THE CHARLES COMPANY FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE LA PUENTE LANES SITE AND ADJACENT PROPERTIES
It is recommended that the Community Development Commission approve the Exclusive Negotiating Agreement extension with the Charles Company.
ENA Charles Company Report
Attachment A
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 503. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this 18th day of April, 2008
______________________________________
Amy M. Turner, City Clerk

REGULAR MEETING OF
April 22, 2008
A Regular Meeting of the Community Development Commission of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on April 22, 2008, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Commissioners present: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan

A-1
READING OF THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF APRIL 8, 2008.
Minutes 4/8/2008
Lujan moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of April 8, 2008 as presented; seconded by Mendoza.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Holloway, and Mendoza. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS

Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Solis moved to approve consent calendar item D-1; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Holloway, and Mendoza. NOES: None.
